title: 1weiho/open-slide
claim: 1weiho/open-slide — A slide framework built for agents.
why_good: open-slide is a framework that allows coding agents to create polished slide decks by handling the canvas, scaling, navigation, and hot reload, enabling a focus on content creation. It supports any coding agent and facilitates seamless slide authoring with built-in commands.
value: Development teams and content creators will pay for open-slide to enhance their presentation workflows and improve the quality of their visual content without needing extensive design skills.
risk: Existing presentation tools like PowerPoint or Google Slides dominate the market, posing a significant challenge for user adoption due to their established user bases and feature sets.
does: open-slide is a framework that allows coding agents to create polished slide decks by handling the canvas, scaling, navigation, and hot reload, enabling a focus on content creation. It supports any coding agent and facilitates seamless slide authoring with built-in commands.
edge: The in-browser inspector allows real-time commenting and editing, which agents can apply instantly, creating a unique feedback loop for rapid iteration.
why_use: Choose open-slide for its agent-native authoring capabilities that eliminate boilerplate and streamline the slide creation process directly from a chat interface.
hook: Transform agent-generated content into stunning presentations with open-slide.

zh.claim: 将代理生成的内容转化为令人惊叹的演示文稿，使用 open-slide。
zh.hook: 使用 open-slide，将代理生成的内容转化为令人惊叹的演示文稿。
zh.does: open-slide 是一个框架，允许编码代理通过处理画布、缩放、导航和热重载来创建精美的幻灯片，专注于内容创作。它支持任何编码代理，并通过内置命令促进无缝的幻灯片创作。
zh.edge: 浏览器内检查器允许实时评论和编辑，代理可以立即应用这些评论，创造出独特的反馈循环，快速迭代。
zh.why_use: 选择 open-slide，因其代理原生创作能力消除了样板代码，并直接从聊天界面简化了幻灯片创建过程。
zh.value: 开发团队和内容创作者将为 open-slide 付费，以提升他们的演示工作流程，并在无需广泛设计技能的情况下提高视觉内容的质量。
zh.risk: 现有的演示工具，如 PowerPoint 或 Google Slides 在市场上占据主导地位，由于其成熟的用户基础和功能集，用户采用面临重大挑战。
zh.why_good: open-slide 是一个框架，允许编码代理通过处理画布、缩放、导航和热重载来创建精美的幻灯片，专注于内容创作。它支持任何编码代理，并通过内置命令促进无缝的幻灯片创作。

pick_reason: The project addresses a specific need for coding agents to create slide decks, but its market potential may be limited.
